submission.justification: Module-D1 at 30% coverage gives the highest simulated light yield, 50.3 PE/MeV. D2 gives 37.6 and D3 gives 24.1 at the same coverage. This recommendation is provisional. The hard constraint, at most 5% module failures after 20 thermal cycles, is unverified for all three designs. No thermal-cycling data exists: the failure fractions and cycles tested are all recorded as -1. Also, no design is verified compliant, and the simulation settings could not be checked against the project documents. D1 is chosen on light yield alone. Before the cryostat is filled, D1 must pass a 20-cycle thermal test with a failure rate of 5% or less. If it fails, the fallback is D2, then D3, and each would need the same test. It is also unknown whether failure rate depends on coverage.

requirements.evidence: D1 at 30% gives 50.252 PE/MeV, the highest of all designs and coverages simulated. D2 gives 37.641 and D3 gives 24.11 at 30%.

requirements.requirement: Module is one of the three designs in candidate_specs.md
At most 5% of modules fail after 20 thermal cycles (hard requirement)
requirements.evidence: No thermal failure data exists for any design. The failure fraction and cycles tested are -1, the status is flagged unverified for D1, D2 and D3, and any_design_verified_compliant=0.
30% is within the allowed range, at its upper bound.
